title: H04 Holdout: an everyday experience from three months back that never became a Memory
capability: Holdout counterpart of the older-ordinary-experience class. Something ordinary that the person told about roughly three months earlier, for which no Claim was ever formed, is found again from the original words when the person asks about it. Recall is not limited to the seven-day default background, small details come from the source, and nothing is invented. A recent episode about the daughter's lessons shares the same activity word and must not be mistaken for it.

allowed.statement: After work the person went into a river on the north side of town with a male cousin, the first open-water dip in years, and kept choking when breathing.
A man fishing on the bank threw the person an old life ring to hold on to.
Getting out, the person had a calf cramp but felt very relaxed on the way home.

forbidden.statement: Saying it was never mentioned, or that nothing about it can be found.
Naming the river, or giving a distance swum or a duration; none was said.
Giving the cousin or the man on the bank a name.
Blending in the daughter's pool lessons, such as the queue to pay, the shallow end or holding her breath, as if they were part of that outing.

time.statement: It was told on 15 July 2026, about three months before the question, and happened that same day after work.

expectedBehavior: Confirm that it was mentioned and retell it from the original words, with the cousin and the life ring.
Place it around mid-July, roughly three months ago.
Keep the daughter's lessons out of it, or mention them only as a clearly separate recent thing.
failureSignals: The three-month-old messages never reach the Provider.
The reply says there is no record.
Details of the daughter's class are told as the person's own outing.

sourceEligibility.reason: Retained original expression of the asked-about experience.
Adjacent original expression of the same experience.

criteria.description: Authoritative history holds exactly the streamed reply.
The three-month-old message and its neighbour reach the Provider.
Asking about the past triggers no Trust Action.
The experience is retold from its source, at the right time.
Nothing is invented and the recent look-alike is not mixed in.
